problem_statement: Build a brand-new Transactions page from scratch on the Kamona-WD starter-dashboard-layout (Vite MPA + vite-plugin-handlebars + AlpineJS + Tailwind v4). The /transactions.html route does not exist yet (baseline is an empty stub). Create src/html/transactions.html by extending the site's shared `layouts/main` Handlebars layout so it reuses the exact shared chrome (sidebar with the site nav, top navbar, and the footer crediting Ahmed Kamel) and Tailwind theme tokens that the Dashboard and Blank pages use. The page shows a data-driven grid of recent transactions (rendered from an inline static dataset, no backend) plus a status-filter bar (All / Income / Expense / Pending) that narrows the visible cards via AlpineJS and updates a live 'Showing N transactions' count heading. Must be mobile-clean at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
required_content: A Transactions page served at /transactions.html, built by extending the shared `layouts/main` layout (NOT a hand-rolled standalone HTML shell) so it inherits the site sidebar, top navbar, and footer.
An intro card titled 'Transaction Activity' with a one-line lede starting 'Review the latest money movement'.

A data-driven grid of transaction cards from an inline static array (Northwind Payroll, Stripe Payout, AWS Cloud, Figma Team, Acme Retainer, Globex Invoice), each showing merchant, category, date, amount, and a status badge.
A status-filter bar with All / Income / Expense / Pending buttons (each carrying data-filter) wired with AlpineJS.
A live count heading 'Showing N transactions' that reflects the currently-visible cards and updates when a filter is clicked (6 by default, 2 for Income).
Register the page in the shared sidebar navigationLinks so 'Transactions' appears in the site-wide nav on every page.
Mobile layout at 390px stacks cards single-column with zero horizontal overflow.
design_constraints: Reuse the site design system via the shared `layouts/main` Handlebars layout + partials (sidebar/navbar/footer) — do not duplicate chrome markup.
Use the repo's Tailwind v4 tokens (bg-white/dark:bg-dark-1, border, rounded-lg, shadow-sm, text-gray-600/dark:text-gray-400) and tabler iconify classes already used elsewhere.
Keep the page self-contained: inline the transaction data, no network/API fetch.

Palette (reuse the shared theme tokens exactly): surface/cards on white bg-white with subtle page bg oklch(0.967 0.003 264.542); 1px borders in oklch(0.928 0.006 264.531) with rounded-lg (6px radius) and the shared shadow-sm; primary body text oklch(0.278 0.033 256.848), muted/secondary text oklch(0.551 0.027 264.364); accent/primary blue oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815) for the active filter button / links; typeface 'Noto Sans' at 16px base (14px meta, 20-24px headings, weights 400/500/600).

Structure: an intro card at the top ('Transaction Activity' heading + lede), then the status-filter bar (All / Income / Expense / Pending), then a live 'Showing N transactions' count heading, then the responsive card grid (multi-column on desktop, single column stacked at 390px). Each transaction card shows merchant, category, date, amount and a status badge.
suggested_files: src/data/index.js (add the Transactions sidebar nav link)
